data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Isidorus, meaning 'given by Isis'. Isis was an ancient Egyptian goddess associated with motherhood, fertility, and magic. In Christian tradition, the name Isborne may represent a strong connection to the divine feminine and spiritual protection. The name Isborne carries the meaning “Dedicated to Isis” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Isborne usually hope their child will grow to embody dedicated to isis and live with faith, good character and purpose.
